CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
